_meta.note: Curated direct bug bounty & VDP programs that do NOT live on HackerOne/Bugcrowd/Intigriti/YesWeHack. Bounty amounts marked approx are public documented figures at time of curation - always verify on the program page. Edit this file to add/remove programs; the site picks it up automatically.

programs.name: Google & Alphabet VRP
programs.summary: The original big-tech bug bounty. Virtually all *.google.com, *.youtube.com, *.blogger.com, *.deepmind.com, *.waymo.com and *.wing.com properties, plus Google apps in the Apple App Store. Paid out $17.1M in 2025 across all Google VRPs.

programs.name: Google Cloud VRP
programs.summary: Dedicated VRP for Google Cloud platform (GCP) products and services, with a top award of $101,010. Over 150 products under the top reward tiers.

programs.name: Google Open Source VRP
programs.summary: Bug bounty for Google's open-source projects (the OSS-VRP). Top reward $31,337. Covers the most sensitive Google OSS repos, supply-chain compromises and design issues.

programs.name: Apple Security Bounty
programs.summary: One of the highest-paying programs in the world: up to $2M for zero-click exploit chains (over $5M with bonuses). Covers iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, watchOS, tvOS, iCloud and wireless proximity attacks. New Target Flags make reward validation faster.

programs.name: Microsoft MSRC Bounty Programs
programs.summary: Microsoft's family of bounty programs: Windows Insider Preview, Microsoft Cloud (Azure), Office 365, Microsoft Edge, Xbox, Dynamics, and up to $250,000 for Hyper-V RCEs. Also the long-running BlueHat prize-style competitions.

programs.name: Meta (Facebook) Bug Bounty
programs.summary: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger and Oculus. Account-takeover chains have historically paid six figures. Known for fast triage and a public researcher directory. Great scope breadth across web and mobile.

programs.name: Intel Product Security Bug Bounty
programs.summary: Intel's program covering CPUs, firmware, software and hardware. Up to $100,000 for the highest-impact findings. Heavily focused on hardware and low-level research - an advanced program.

programs.name: Signal Bug Bounty Program
programs.summary: The encrypted-messaging app pays up to $100,000 for remote code execution as the user, plus bounties for a range of other vulnerability classes in the Signal clients and server. Small, high-quality scope - read their detailed matrix.

programs.name: Zero Day Initiative (ZDI)
programs.summary: The world's oldest and largest vendor-neutral 0-day acquisition program (owned by Trend Micro). Variable payouts - frequently six figures for high-quality 0-days in widely deployed software. Also runs the Pwn2Own hacking competitions.

targets.target: Vulnerability research: browsers, OS kernels, virtualization, ICS

programs.name: Mozilla Firefox Bug Bounty
programs.summary: Firefox, Firefox for Android/iOS, Firefox Focus and related web properties. Bounties scale by severity - a classic program for learning browser and web exploitation with an extremely transparent hall of fame.

programs.name: Tor Project Bug Bounty & VDP
programs.summary: Tor runs a vulnerability disclosure program for the Tor network, Tor Browser and infrastructure. Rewards are mostly swag (the famous Tor t-shirt) and hall-of-fame credit - an ideal, forgiving practice ground with real security impact.

programs.name: Apache Software Foundation Security VDP
programs.summary: Report vulnerabilities in any Apache project (350+ open-source projects: httpd, Kafka, Struts, Log4j...). No cash bounty, but ASF thanks and credit - excellent for learning open-source code review on real, widely deployed code.

programs.name: Immunefi (Web3 Bug Bounty Hub)
programs.summary: The largest Web3 bug bounty platform: 150+ live smart-contract and blockchain programs, 40+ criticals confirmed monthly. Max bounties reach into the millions. Requires solid Solidity/EVM skills - the highest payout density in bug bounty.

targets.target: DeFi, bridges, L1/L2 protocols, NFT contracts

programs.name: Ethena (Web3)
programs.summary: One of the highest maximum bounties currently live on Immunefi - $3M for critical findings in the Ethena protocol (synthetic dollar protocol on Ethereum). Find the program via Immunefi's explorer.

programs.name: Lombard Finance (Web3)
programs.summary: Bitcoin liquid-staking protocol with a $500k maximum bounty on Immunefi. Smart contract focus.

programs.name: SSV Network (Web3)
programs.summary: Distributed Ethereum staking infrastructure - $250k max bounty on Immunefi. Contract + validator infrastructure scope.

programs.name: ENS - Ethereum Name Service (Web3)
programs.summary: The naming protocol of Ethereum - $250k max bounty, triaged by Immunefi. Heavily audited, high competition, great learning material.

programs.name: The Graph (Web3)
programs.summary: Indexing protocol for blockchain data - $50k max bounty with $1.6M+ already paid out and a fast 1-day median resolution time on Immunefi.

programs.name: Hedera (Web3)
programs.summary: Enterprise-grade hashgraph network - $30k max bounty on Immunefi, triaged directly by the platform.
